from solution import is_Diff
import inspect


def test_issue_example_12345():
    """Example: is_Diff(12345) == False."""
    # even: 2+4=6, odd: 1+3+5=9
    assert is_Diff(12345) == False


def test_issue_reordered_digits_54321():
    """Sums of even and odd digits do not depend on digit order."""
    # even: 4+2=6, odd: 5+3+1=9, same sums as 12345
    assert is_Diff(54321) == False


def test_issue_reordered_digits_21435():
    """Sums of even and odd digits do not depend on digit order."""
    # even: 2+4=6, odd: 1+3+5=9, same sums as 12345
    assert is_Diff(21435) == False


def test_issue_inserted_zero_102345():
    """Adding even digit 0 leaves even and odd sums unchanged."""
    # even: 0+2+4=6, odd: 1+3+5=9, same sums as 12345
    assert is_Diff(102345) == False


def test_issue_appended_zero_123450():
    """Adding even digit 0 leaves even and odd sums unchanged."""
    # even: 2+4+0=6, odd: 1+3+5=9, same sums as 12345
    assert is_Diff(123450) == False


def test_contract_returns_bool():
    """Example compares to False so is_Diff must return a boolean."""
    assert isinstance(is_Diff(12345), bool)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface is is_Diff(n) with one argument."""
    assert callable(is_Diff)
    assert len(inspect.signature(is_Diff).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_handles_zero():
    """Function handles boundary input zero."""
    assert isinstance(is_Diff(0), bool)


def test_contract_handles_large_number():
    """Function handles a large input without error."""
    # digits include evens and odds, only check it returns bool
    assert isinstance(is_Diff(9876543210123456789), bool)


def test_contract_is_deterministic():
    """Repeated calls with the same input give the same result."""
    assert is_Diff(12345) == is_Diff(12345)
